name: Watashi to Kimi no Chiisana Mahou
source:
The protagonist, Ruruka, is a young witch apprentice witch living alone in the forest. One day, she encounters Seina, a star child who has fallen to Earth. As they begin living together, their days are filled with warmth and happiness… but something is about to change. 

[From [url=https://asami-iris.itch.io/my-little-magic-with-you]itch.io[/url]]
